_comment: License determinations for the components that appear in the tl_matter SBOM.
zspdx can only read an explicit 'SPDX-License-Identifier:' tag. Several
upstream projects instead embed the full license text -- openthread's
sources carry the complete 28-line BSD-3-Clause body with no tag -- so all
of their files come back NONE and the package ends up NOASSERTION.
This file is the human answer to that. It is read by enrich_sbom.py and is
meant to be edited by the team, not generated. Keys are 'org/repo' exactly
as they appear in the SPDX PackageDownloadLocation.
'licenses' entries are confirmed and applied automatically.
'needs_review' entries are NOT applied -- they are listed so the review
report can explain why a component is still unresolved. Move an entry up
to 'licenses' once someone has confirmed it.
Only SPDX license identifiers or SPDX expressions belong in 'licenses'.
The script validates the value is non-empty but cannot verify it is a real
SPDX id -- that is the reviewer's responsibility.

needs_review.zephyrproject-rtos/fatfs: No LICENSE file the GitHub API can identify. FatFs uses a custom permissive license (SPDX: BSD-1-Clause); confirm against the source headers.
needs_review.zephyrproject-rtos/tinycrypt: No LICENSE file the GitHub API can identify. Confirm from the source headers.
needs_review.zephyrproject-rtos/percepio: No LICENSE file the GitHub API can identify. TraceRecorder is believed MIT; confirm.
needs_review.zephyrproject-rtos/segger: No LICENSE file the GitHub API can identify. Confirm from the source headers.
needs_review.zephyrproject-rtos/picolibc: GitHub API reports NOASSERTION -- picolibc is a mix of BSD-2-Clause and MIT. Needs a compound expression.
needs_review.telink-semi/hal_telink: No LICENSE file at the repository root. This is Telink's own code and needs an internal legal determination.
needs_review.telink-semi/xz: GitHub API reports NOASSERTION -- XZ Utils is public domain OR LGPL-2.1-or-later depending on the file. Needs a compound expression.
needs_review.telink-semi/openthread_telink_lib: Telink fork of the OpenThread library. Likely inherits OpenThread's BSD-3-Clause; confirm.
needs_review.telink-semi/nfc_st25dv: Telink component. Needs an internal determination.
needs_review.telink-semi/tl_st25dv: Telink component. Needs an internal determination.
needs_review.telink-semi/tflite-micro-telink: Telink fork of TensorFlow Lite Micro. Likely Apache-2.0; confirm.
needs_review.Aaronlu1/tl_matter: The Matter stack itself. connectedhomeip is Apache-2.0; on the company repository this key becomes 'telink-semi/tl_matter'.
needs_review.Mbed-TLS/mbedtls: Duplicate view of mbedtls. zspdx reports the module twice with different purls: 'zephyrproject-rtos/mbedtls' (the Zephyr module, which resolves) and 'Mbed-TLS/mbedtls' (upstream, from modules-deps.spdx). Same code, same license: Apache-2.0 OR GPL-2.0-or-later.
